name: beats: a sentence within its words but over its letters is cut too, since it is the letters that take the time to say: at a comma before "and" with a subject and a whole clause after it, at a comma before "so" whatever follows it, and at a semicolon; never at a colon, and never before the last thing of a list ("..., and the Pembroke Cambridge summer program"), which would be left standing alone; a list after "like" has no place to cut and stays whole; a sentence under the letters is left as it is

sentences.and the: This year's deadline was November 2, thirteen days ago, and the Faculty Led Programs Maymester page says 2027 applications have closed.
sentences.a semicolon: Re-establishing groups first submit the officer form; new groups use Register a new Recognized Student Organization in the EngageSC Directory.
sentences.a colon and a list: Its table lists when each term opens and closes: spring, fall or academic year, and the Pembroke Cambridge summer program.
sentences.a list after like: The 2027 Courses section lists five options, like marine microbiology, scientific diving, and coastal environmental history.
sentences.short enough: Yes: each officer must finish Hazing Prevention 101 before the application deadline.
sentences.so, and a short clause: Not through this page, since its noon deadline of April 24, 2026 is already behind us, so contact the international programs office.
